focus_areas: Hairline integration: Check if the wig's front edge blends unnaturally into the skin.
Hand-object interaction: Verify the structural integrity of the hands holding objects or touching the face.
Texture consistency: Ensure the 'hair' texture doesn't melt into plastic or smear in low-detail areas.
Background coherence: Check if the background faces and objects maintain structural plausibility despite blur.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the distinction between 'old photo quality' (grain, flash glare) and 'AI artifacts' (melting anatomy, impossible geometry). The hands are a high-risk area for AI errors. The white object in the back is ambiguous—determine if it's a valid wig component (cap) or a generation failure. Do not penalize heavily for low resolution if the underlying structure is sound.
image_description: A candid, low-resolution photograph of a group of people at a party or social gathering. The central focus is a woman in the foreground wearing a short, brown, shag-style wig. To her right, another person wears a long, dark wig with a headband. In the background, a man holds up a white, textured object that resembles a wig cap or a bald-cap style wig. Another person on the left has purple-tinted hair, possibly dyed or a wig. The lighting is harsh (flash photography), and the image quality is grainy.
